judgments.observed: After clicking 'Organizations', the URL changed to /explore/users and the page rendered, but a JavaScript console error appeared: "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'render')".
judgments.expected: A correct application should navigate to /explore/users without producing uncaught JavaScript errors in the console.
judgments.discrepancy: The console error indicates the application threw an exception during rendering, which a correct app would not do.
judgments.evidence: console    : Cannot read properties of null (reading 'render')

judgments.observed: Clicking the 'Export results' button left the URL at /explore/repos and the page content unchanged, with no network request recorded.
judgments.expected: Clicking 'Export results' should initiate an export operation, such as starting a file download or navigating to an export endpoint, resulting in a visible effect or a network request.
judgments.discrepancy: The control produced no observable effect despite its label promising an export action, which contradicts expected behavior.
judgments.evidence: NO OBSERVABLE CHANGE — the page is byte-identical after this action

judgments.observed: Resizing the viewport to mobile hid the top navigation links (Explore, Help, Register, an unnamed link) and showed language links (English, Español, Français, Italiano). The URL stayed the same.
judgments.expected: A responsive UI may hide certain top navigation items on a small viewport, typically moving them to a hamburger menu, and display language selection links. No error or broken behavior is expected.
judgments.evidence: now hidden : a 'Explore', a 'Help', a 'Register', a (unnamed)

judgments.observed: Resizing the viewport to desktop made the navigation links (Explore, Help, Register, etc.) visible again and hid the language selection links, with no URL change.
judgments.expected: A correct responsive UI should restore the desktop navigation elements and hide the mobile-only language links when the viewport is switched back to desktop size.
judgments.evidence: now shown  : a 'Explore', a 'Help', a 'Register', a (unnamed)

judgments.observed: The input field 'q' was updated from empty to the value 'search query', with the URL unchanged.
judgments.expected: Typing into a search box should update the field's value without navigation or errors.

judgments.observed: Clicking Search navigated to /explore/repos?sort=recentupdate&language=&q=search+query&only_show_relevant=false and displayed the text "No matching repositories found."
judgments.expected: Search should submit the query and show results; for an unmatched keyword it should display an empty result list with an appropriate message, staying on the same route with query parameters.
judgments.evidence: page text  : No matching repositories found. | Powered by Gitea | Version: 1.21.11 Page:

judgments.observed: Clicking the 'Users' link navigated to /explore/users, updated the page content, but the browser console logged a JavaScript error: "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'render')".
judgments.expected: Navigation to the users explore page should occur without any uncaught JavaScript errors; the console should remain error‑free.
judgments.discrepancy: A JavaScript error appeared after the navigation, which a correct application would not produce.
judgments.evidence: console    : Cannot read properties of null (reading 'render')

judgments.observed: Click on the repository link navigated from /explore/repos to /tester/notes, updated title and page text to show the repository, changed form state, and the page was still mutating after 3.2 seconds
judgments.expected: The link should navigate to the repository page and display its content; the page may load asynchronously but is not required to settle instantly
judgments.evidence: NOT SETTLED: the page was still mutating after 3.2s

judgments.observed: NO_OP action caused no visible change: URL remained /tester/notes, no text, form, or layout updates were reported.
judgments.expected: A NO_OP should not produce any observable change; the page may continue loading asynchronously, which is acceptable.

judgments.observed: The page remained mutating after the NO_OP action; the window notes 'NOT SETTLED: the page was still mutating after 3.0s' with no observable changes in text, form or layout.
judgments.expected: After a brief period the page should reach a settled state with no ongoing mutations, especially after a NO_OP that does not trigger any activity.
judgments.discrepancy: The page continues to mutate after 3 seconds, indicating it has not settled as a correct application would.
judgments.evidence: NOT SETTLED: the page was still mutating after 3.0s

judgments.observed: NO_OP executed; URL remained /tester/notes; page continued mutating after 3.0s with no recorded changes to text, form, or layout fields
judgments.expected: NO_OP should produce no observable changes; the page may still be loading but no errors or unexpected UI changes are required
judgments.evidence: action     : NO_OP ... NOT SETTLED: the page was still mutating after 3.0s

judgments.observed: The page remained in a mutating state after the NO_OP action, with the log noting "NOT SETTLED: the page was still mutating after 3.0s" and no settled content change reported.
judgments.expected: A settled page where all asynchronous loading completes, causing the mutating flag to clear within a reasonable time.
judgments.discrepancy: The page never settled; it continued mutating beyond the expected loading period, indicating a hang.
judgments.evidence: NOT SETTLED: the page was still mutating after 3.0s

judgments.observed: Clicking the 'Repositories' link resulted in no URL change (still /explore/repos) and no observable changes in the summarized page content.
judgments.expected: The 'Repositories' link should navigate to /explore/repos (the same URL), which may refresh the page but does not need to alter the URL or visible content.

judgments.observed: Clicking 'Register' navigated from /explore/repos to /user/sign_up, displaying the registration page with empty username, email, password, and retype fields.
judgments.expected: A navigation link to the registration page should load /user/sign_up and show the registration form with empty input fields.
